svg.title: Kinfolk architecture
svg.desc: Kinfolk architecture. 6 components in 2 groups. Connections: Browser to Vite SPA (static bundle); Browser to Next.js JSON API (JSON, bearer token); Browser to Next.js fallback (httpOnly cookie); Browser to GitHub OAuth (authorize); Vercel, sin1 to GitHub OAuth (code exchange); Vercel, sin1 to Neon Postgres (Drizzle over HTTP).

text.tspan: A static SPA on GitHub Pages and a Next.js app on Vercel share one API and one Neon database
